latest_release.name: v1.4.0
latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* Bump vite from 8.1.3 to 8.3.5 in /workbench by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/laravel/ai/pull/1166
* Preserve input order for batch embeddings from OpenAI by @paulinevos in https://github.com/laravel/ai/pull/1172
* Skip credit pattern matching when the error message is not a string by @lazerg in https://github.com/laravel/ai/pull/1157
* [1.x] Report the stored message ids in RUN_FINISHED metadata by @MohannadElemary in https://github.com/laravel/ai/pull/1165
* Update Mistral models to latest versions by @GeorgeBetts in https://github.com/laravel/ai/pull/1173
* Add handling for OpenAI insufficient credits and quota errors by @grzegorczykp in https://github.com/laravel/ai/pull/1174
* Expose the raw HTTP response on classification responses by @pushpak1300 in https://github.com/laravel/ai/pull/1178
* Expose the raw HTTP response on embeddings responses by @pushpak1300 in https://github.com/laravel/ai/pull/1181
* Expose the raw HTTP response on transcription responses by @pushpak1300 in https://github.com/laravel/ai/pull/1180
* Expose the raw HTTP response on image responses by @pushpak1300 in https://github.com/laravel/ai/pull/1179
* Expose the raw HTTP response on reranking responses by @pushpak1300 in https://github.com/laravel/ai/pull/1182
* Rebuild a resumed turn's content from its merged steps by @TPSJASPER in https://github.com/laravel/ai/pull/1162
* [1.x] Let agent fakes resume tool approvals by @pascalbaljet in https://github.com/laravel/ai/pull/1190
* Run Anthropic tool calls when the message ends with end_turn by @lazerg in https://github.com/laravel/ai/pull/1188
* Pin hosts with a trailing dot as written in the URL by @dwivedianuj9118 in https://github.com/laravel/ai/pull/1193
* [1.x] Let agents recover from tool failures by @pascalbaljet in https://github.com/laravel/ai/pull/1191
* Join streamed text across Anthropic pause_turn continuations by @lazerg in https://github.com/laravel/ai/pull/1186
* Report conversation title generation as an agent run by @pushpak1300 in https://github.com/laravel/ai/pull/1203
* Accept array criteria on boolean questions sent to OpenAI decisions by @Taldres in https://github.com/laravel/ai/pull/1202
* Broadcast provider stream errors under a fixed name by @crishoj in https://github.com/laravel/ai/pull/1208
* Send OpenAI custom voices as an object by @lazerg in https://github.com/laravel/ai/pull/1212
* Run OpenAI-compatible tool calls sent without an index or finished with stop by @pushpak1300 in https://github.com/laravel/ai/pull/1192

## New Contributors
* @MohannadElemary made their first contribution in https://github.com/laravel/ai/pull/1165
* @grzegorczykp made their first contribution in https://github.com/laravel/ai/pull/1174
* @TPSJASPER made their first contribution in https://github.com/laravel/ai/pull/1162
* @dwivedianuj9118 made their first contribution in https://github.com/laravel/ai/pull/1193

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/laravel/ai/compare/v1.3.0...v1.4.0

detail.readme: ## Introduction The Laravel AI SDK provides a unified, expressive API for interacting with AI providers such as OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, and more. With the AI SDK, you can build intelligent agents with tools and structured output, generate images, synthesize and transcribe audio, create vector embeddings, and much more — all using a consistent, Laravel-friendly interface. ## Documentation Documentation for the Laravel AI SDK can be found on the [Laravel website](https://laravel.com/docs/ai-sdk). ## Contributing Thank you for considering contributing to Laravel! The contribution guide can be found in the [Laravel documentation](https://laravel.com/docs/contributions). ## Code of Conduct In order to ensure that the Laravel community is welcoming to all, please review and abide by the [Code of Conduct](https://laravel.com/docs/contributions#code-of-conduct). ## Security Vulnerabilities Please review [our security policy](https://github.com/laravel/ai/security/policy) on how to report security vulnerabilities. ## License The Laravel AI SDK is open-sourced software licensed under the [MIT license](LICENSE.md).
